import pytest
from rich.console import Console

def test_nerd_font_double_width() -> None:
    console = Console(record=True)
    console.print("\U000f024d")  # This is the nerd font character for downloads folder
    output = console.export_text()
    assert output.count("\U000f024d") == 1  # Should be counted as a single character
